name: Anglo American plc
source: CRON 2026-11-12: this market-suffixed copy was synchronised byte for byte with the resolved-ticker file static_data/financials/AGL__income.json so the panel serves the same column whichever key it requests. | CRON 2026-11-12: H1 2026 column added from Anglo American plc Interim Results 2026 (six months ended 30 June 2026), consolidated income statement page 41 combined with note 8 discontinued operations page 58, US$ million scaled to units. Continuing operations: Revenue 9,926, Operating costs 7,462, Operating profit 2,464, Net finance costs 225, Profit before tax 2,268, Income tax 1,412, profit 856. Discontinued operations (Steelmaking Coal and Nickel): Revenue 1,022, Operating costs 1,196 plus operating special items 948 = 2,144, operating loss 1,122, net finance costs 30, loss before tax 1,169, income tax credit 10, loss 1,159. Totals stored: Revenue 10,948, Operating Expenses 9,606, EBIT 1,342, Net Finance Costs 255, Profit Before Tax 1,099, Income Tax 1,402, Net Profit -303. Checks: 10,948 less 9,606 equals 1,342; 1,099 less 1,402 equals -303, the printed Loss for the financial period. Anglo prints no cost of sales or gross profit split, so those two rows are left empty rather than allocated. Net Profit is the total loss for the period; the printed Loss attributable to equity shareholders is -858 after 555 attributable to non-controlling interests, and the printed basic loss per share of -0.80 is on that attributable basis, so EPS is stored as printed. The Group also reports continuing operations earnings per share of 0.28. | Yahoo Finance
